report.title: Checkout failures due to Fabrikam Payments outage since 2026-11-27T17:41Z
report.summary: Since ~2026-11-27T17:41Z the third-party payment provider Fabrikam Payments is returning 503s, causing payment-service errors and a drop in checkout success rate starting 2026-11-27T17:42Z. Checkout success rate fell from ~0.985 to ~0.60 and remains low.
report.customerImpact: Customers cannot complete purchases that require card charges; checkout success rate is ~60% (below the 90% alert threshold) and p95 latency across checkout is elevated (checkout-api p95 ~8.5s), increasing abandonment and revenue impact.

rootCause.description: Payment-service is receiving 503 Service Unavailable from Fabrikam Payments starting 2026-11-27T17:41Z; payment-service retries 4x with no backoff and surfaces errors to checkout-api, causing failed checkouts and high latencies.

evidence.detail: checkout-api checkout_success_rate: baseline 0.9851 -> latest 0.605, drop detected starting 2026-11-27T17:42Z (change -38.6%). (queryMetrics)
payment-service provider_error_rate: baseline 0.002 -> latest 0.6455, spike detected starting 2026-11-27T17:41Z (queryMetrics)

240 ERROR lines: 'Fabrikam Payments returned <n> Service Unavailable for POST /v2/charges orderId=... attempt=<n>/<n>' and info lines noting 'Major outage: card processing (us-east)' since 2026-11-27T17:41Z (searchLogs) ; sample ERROR at 2026-11-27T18:00Z showing 503 on attempt=4/4.

Distributed traces for failed checkouts at 2026-11-27T17:44–17:59 show payment-service span lasting ~8s and note '4 attempts to Fabrikam Payments, all 503, no backoff' leading to error and overall request durations ~8s (getTraces).

recommendedActions.target: payment-service -> use backup provider 'AltPay' (configured in service config)
recommendedActions.rationale: Third-party Fabrikam is returning 503s starting 17:41Z; failing over to the backup provider will restore payment success quickly and reduce latency compared to retries to a failing provider.

Current behavior retries 4x with no backoff causing high latencies and queueing; enable or lower threshold circuit breaker to fail fast to the backup and avoid long p95 latencies impacting checkout-web and checkout-api.
No recent deploys detected to checkout-api or payment-service in last 48h; not applicable — include as no-op to note investigation. Recommend no rollout actions.

recommendedActions.target: checkout-api and payment-service metrics and Fabrikam status page
recommendedActions.rationale: After failover/circuit-breaker, monitor checkout_success_rate, payment provider_error_rate, p95 latency, and duplicate_charges_per_min to ensure no double-charges or idempotency issues.
Open incident with Fabrikam (include timestamps, sample request ids from logs), request ETA and mitigation. Also prepare communications for ops/CS if impact continues.

followUps: Verify backup provider credentials/certificates are valid before full cutover; if not, rotate or configure (getServiceConfig).
After failover, review payment-service retry/backoff and idempotency to prevent duplicate charges and reduce latency: consider exponential backoff and early circuit breaker.
If failover is not possible, implement user-facing degradations (save cart + email checkout link) to avoid lost orders.
